Why choose us

The reliable choice for a cleaner property

Anyone can hire a jet wash. We bring the care, consistency and courtesy of a professional team — and we treat every property as if it were our own.

Professional & reliable

We turn up when we say we will, in uniform, with the right equipment for the job — and we keep you informed from quote to completion.

Attention to detail

Edges, corners, frames and the finishing touches others skip. We check our work before we pack away — because the details are the difference.

Friendly customer service

Real people, straight answers and a team that’s happy to help. Questions before, during or after your clean? Just ask.

Quality results

Professional-grade equipment and proven methods, matched to each surface — for a deep clean that lasts, without cutting corners.

Hassle-free bookings

One simple form, a clear written quote and a time that suits you. No pressure, no obligation — just a straightforward service from start to finish.

About MSH Commercial Limited

Your Property. Our Priority.

We provide reliable cleaning and exterior maintenance services, helping residential and commercial customers maintain clean, presentable and welcoming properties.

From a single driveway revival to regular window cleaning rounds and full property clearances, MSH Commercial Limited brings the same care and professionalism to every job — large or small. We believe a well-kept property makes a lasting impression, and we’re here to make keeping yours effortless.

  • One team for cleaning & clearance
  • Clear quotes before we start
  • One-off jobs & regular visits
  • We leave every site tidy

Good to know

Frequently asked questions

Every property is different, so we price each job individually based on its size, condition and access. Send us the quote form and we’ll come back with a clear, fixed price — free and with no obligation to go ahead.

We’re a UK-based team covering local homes and businesses. Add your postcode to the quote form and we’ll confirm coverage for your address when we reply with your quote.

For most exterior work, no — as long as we have access to the area and an outdoor tap for pressure washing and window cleaning. We’ll agree everything with you beforehand, and let you know as soon as we’re finished.

We remove most household, garden and general commercial waste — including furniture, appliances, rubble bags and green waste. If you’re unsure about a particular item, mention it in your message and we’ll advise when we quote.

Yes — window cleaning rounds and scheduled exterior maintenance are available for both homes and commercial premises. Mention that you’d like a regular service in your message and we’ll include options in your quote.
